_bundled_secrets_doc: 0.2.0 fork-readiness sweep (item H1, 2026-05-08): the orchestrator core declares the secrets the launcher itself manages (PAT for GitHub auth, etc.) so the hub's `/api/v1/projects/{id}/env` resolver can serve them to bundled wrappers without the user having to install a separate module first. Each entry maps a single keychain slot — the hub uses the SENTINEL_SHARED project_id for shared scope (so all base-host projects see the same value) and the OnboardingWizard's `register_github_pat` writes to the matching slot. 2026-05-10 (post-0.2.0 backlog #6): module_id changed from 'installer' to 'user' so the wizard's writer matches the SecretsPanel 'Shared (this user)' tab's UI_MODULE_BUCKET — registering via either path now lands at the same keychain row instead of two divergent ones.

bundled_secrets.description: GitHub personal access token written by the launcher's OnboardingWizard via `register_github_pat` AND by the SecretsPanel 'Shared (this user)' tab. Resolved by the hub for every base-host project; consumed by `claude_mcp_servers/search_mcp/wrapper.sh` (renamed to GITHUB_TOKEN) and bundled hooks that need to talk to GitHub.
